description: This file defines the class TimesheetEntriesParamRule, which implements validation logic for timesheet entry parameters within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for validating entries such as project IDs, activity IDs, date ranges, and durations, utilizing other validation rules and service traits.

classes.name: TimesheetEntriesParamRule
classes.description: A validation rule class for validating timesheet entries parameters, ensuring proper fields, date ranges, durations, and associations between activities and projects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the timesheet ID for validation context.

methods.name: getApiDateRule
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of ApiDate for date validation.

methods.name: getTimeRule
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of Time for duration validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates an array of timesheet entries, checking structure, required fields, date ranges, durations, and data consistency with existing entities.
